electrode_spec.name: Silicon-graphite electrode, aqueous processed, lower Si % (IntelLiGent batch 1, SINTEF)
electrode_spec.description: Lower Si % silicon-graphite composite (aqueous processed). Electrode design of the IntelLiGent project batch 1 (SINTEF), published under the label SiGr-AQ-1. Active-material type as stated in metadata.csv: "Silicon Graphite".

processing.detail: Aqueous electrode coating (water), as stated by the public electrode label SiGr-AQ-1 and the Zenodo batch table.

notes: Design values are as published in metadata.csv for batch SiGr-AQ-1, the one batch that realizes this design. The as-built figures of each individual disc are on the 8 electrode records that cite this spec.

Active-mass loading: mean 4.7837 mg/cm2, sample standard deviation 0.1827 mg/cm2 over n = 8 discs (range 4.5479-4.99 mg/cm2). Computed from the per-cell values metadata.csv publishes for this batch and carried on the quantity itself, not in this note.
Dry thickness: 74.0 um for every one of the 8 discs. metadata.csv states this one value per cell, so the standard deviation is 0 by construction - a repeated declaration, not a measured spread.

Nominal areal capacity: mean 2.4397 mAh/cm2, sample standard deviation 0.0932 mAh/cm2 over n = 8 discs (range 2.3194-2.5449 mAh/cm2). Computed from the per-cell values metadata.csv publishes for this batch and carried on the quantity itself, not in this note.

Theoretical specific capacity is stated here rather than on the powder because the source gives a different value for each silicon-graphite composite blend (510 mAh/g for this one), which makes it a property of the design.
